name: Qualifacts CareLogic
short_description: Enterprise behavioral health EHR for community mental health centers and CCBHCs with comprehensive clinical, billing, and compliance capabilities.
long_description: Qualifacts CareLogic is an enterprise-grade behavioral health EHR designed for community mental health centers, Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHCs), and large behavioral health organizations. Part of the Qualifacts portfolio (headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee), CareLogic serves more than 2,700 organizations across all 50 states, including 33% of the nation's CCBHCs. The platform offers comprehensive clinical documentation, treatment planning, scheduling, billing and revenue cycle management, outcome tracking, advanced analytics, and reporting dashboards. CareLogic is engineered for enterprise-level organizations with complex needs including multi-location or multi-state operations, Autism/IDD agencies, SUD treatment programs, and organizations requiring robust compliance reporting. The platform includes mobile accessibility and an integrated patient portal for care coordination.
one_liner: Enterprise behavioral health EHR powering 33% of America's CCBHCs.
best_for: Community mental health centers (CMHCs) with complex reporting needs
Autism/IDD agencies and SUD treatment programs
not_for: Solo practitioners or small private practices
Practices seeking quick implementation without customization
General medical practices outside behavioral health

pricing.notes: Custom quote-based pricing. Starting costs approximately $50/provider/month based on industry benchmarks. Organizations should budget $50,000+ annually. Advanced analytics add-on approximately $500/month additional. Implementation, training, and data migration costs are additional. Contact Qualifacts for enterprise pricing.

faqs.q: How much does Qualifacts CareLogic cost?
faqs.a: CareLogic uses custom enterprise pricing starting around $50/provider/month. Organizations should budget $50,000+ annually. Advanced analytics, implementation, and training are additional costs. Contact Qualifacts for a custom quote.

faqs.q: What types of organizations use CareLogic?
faqs.a: CareLogic serves community mental health centers, CCBHCs, multi-location behavioral health organizations, Autism/IDD agencies, and SUD treatment programs. It's designed for mid-size to enterprise organizations, not solo practitioners.

Yes, CareLogic is specifically engineered to support CCBHCs, serving 33% of the nation's Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics. It includes compliance reporting and outcome tracking required for CCBHC certification.

faqs.q: What is the difference between CareLogic and Credible?
faqs.a: Both are Qualifacts products. CareLogic is designed for community mental health and large behavioral health organizations, while Credible is positioned for enterprise agencies and CCBHCs with even more complex needs. Both serve large organizations.
